data.title: Payment reminder: utility costs back payment 2024
data.summary: The property manager Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner reminds you that a back payment of €286.14 from the 2024 utility costs statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) is still unpaid. It asks for payment by 27 February 2026.
data.explanation: This is a friendly payment reminder, not a court letter. Your 2024 utility costs statement dated 15 December 2025 resulted in a back payment of €286.14, which the manager has not received. Please transfer the amount to the account named in the letter by 27 February 2026, using your tenant number as a reference. If you already paid, you can ignore the letter. If you think the statement is wrong, check it and contact the manager or a tenants' association (Mieterverein) for advice.
